theorem typeII_first {α δ T : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hT : 6e6 ≤ T)
    (h : Approx2 α (T ^ 3) δ a q (3 / 4 * T ^ 2)) (hqT : (q : ℝ) ≤ T / 6) :
    ‖typeII α (T ^ 3) (U1 T (delta0 δ * q)) (V1 T)‖ ≤
      T ^ 3 / √(delta0 δ * Nat.totient q) *
          (√(Cxt T (delta0 δ * q) * (Real.log (delta0 δ * q) + 0.002) +
              Real.log (4 * (delta0 δ * q)) / 2) *
            √(0.30214 * Real.log (delta0 δ * q) + 0.7468)) +
        3.2 * (T ^ 2 * √T) :=

note: Lean now assumes V ≥ 2·10⁶, the chapter's standing assumption, and Q ≥ 3.5x/U, which Prop 5.2.4 needs but Ch. Erratum: The main term of (6.37) inherits the (5.36) error: its second factor needs + 4E(x/UV), which is 0.0922 for x/UV >= 16, and the first choice reaches x/UV = 2 sqrt(q delta_0) up to 2828. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_6_37.py`).
